newsitem.title: FRANCE: Niger students hold diplomats hostage in Algiers.
newsitem.headline: Niger students hold diplomats hostage in Algiers.

text.p: About 200 cash-strapped students from Niger were holding three Niger embassy diplomats hostage in the Algerian capital to pressure the Niamey government for money, a student leader said on Thursday.
"We will not leave until the authorities satisfy our demands," said Tahar Hamani, speaking by telephone on behalf of the students holed up in the embassy in Algiers.
He said that Niger's government had scrapped a $40 a month scholarship allowance for the students and they were forced to live on the 900 dinars ($16) a month they received from Algeria.

There were no reports of violence and a Niger diplomat who answered the telephone in the Algiers embassy played down the hostage-taking claim and said he and his two colleagues were trying to work with the students to solve their financial problems. ($=55 dinars)
